messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: orbit-service v2.4.0 -> rollouts/orbit/canary at 09:00 UTC. Expected ~15m.

taylor: launching now, tagging release notes and metrics dashboard.

maria: seeing a spike in control-plane CPU in us-east-1 right as canary started. Noticing `controller-compile` threads at 95%.

oncall: CC @sre-lead — is this related to last night's config push?

sre-lead: looking. Correlating with a scheduled model-compile job that hit the control-plane at 08:58. Might be contention with rollout updater.

qadev: can we pause the canary while we confirm? We have a model latency flake in staging.

taylor: yes please pause. deploy-bot, pause rollout.

deploy-bot: ✅ Received: pause rollouts/orbit/canary by request of taylor at 1742106795. Current canary instances left unchanged.

maria: thanks. seeing request queue backpressure drop after pause. CPU trending down.

sre-lead: I'll scale down the compile workers and rerun with rate-limit. Will update in 10m.

qadev: should we pin traffic back to orbit v2.3.9 for safety? Canary only had 3 pods up but if it regresses we should fallback.

taylor: good call. Pinning to v2.3.9 and creating a rollback plan.

deploy-bot: ⚠️ Action required: set service pin: `kubectl annotate svc orbit traffic-pin=v2.3.9 --overwrite` — request queued.

maria: doing the annotation now.

maria: annotated. traffic confirmed on v2.3.9 (3 replicas).

taylor: documenting in release notes: "canary paused due to control-plane CPU pressure; traffic pinned to v2.3.9; reschedule pending." Adding ETA for reschedule after mitigation.

sre-lead: mitigation done: compile workers rate-limited to 25% and put on a cron window outside deploy windows. Control-plane CPU stable.

qadev: canary resume checklist: health checks passing, tracing ok, no error-rate uptick, perf within 10% of baseline.

taylor: +1. propose reschedule window at 11:30 UTC to allow propagation and extra monitoring.

maria: 11:30 UTC works for us. Recommend double-canary (staggered) with 5m observation between increments.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: resume rollouts/orbit/canary at 1742109000 (11:30 UTC). Postponed from 1742106789. Notification will be sent to channel.

taylor: I'll run a smoke test and keep the dashboard open. If anything odd, we abort and keep traffic pinned.

sre-lead: logging RCA note: incidental collision between model-compile job and rollout updater; adding cross-team deploy window doc.

qadev: adding regression tests for model-compile backpressure to CI to catch this earlier.

maria: TY everyone. Closing pause: follow-up thread for RCA details under #postmortems.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot at 1742109350. Resume scheduled: 1742109000.
